sources.title: A 5′ UTR language model for decoding untranslated regions of ... - Nature
sources.snippet: Language models have showcased their effectiveness in decoding the functions of protein and genome sequences. Here, we introduce a language model for 5′ UTR, which we refer to as the UTR-LM.
